name: slicer-handoff
description: Hands models to the right slicer: full-spectrum (Snapmaker U1) files Claude tries to open in Bambu Studio go to Snapmaker Orca instead, and previous slicer windows are gently quit first so they don't pile up. /slice opens a file the same way.

closePrevious.title: Close previous slicer windows
closePrevious.description: Before a model opens in a slicer, ask that slicer's running instances to quit normally (they still ask to save unsaved work; nothing is ever killed).

fullSpectrumPattern.title: Full-spectrum file names (regex)
fullSpectrumPattern.description: A case-insensitive regular expression for paths of full-spectrum (Snapmaker U1 only) files, matched against the file name and its folders.

checkContents.title: Look inside 3MF files
checkContents.description: When a 3MF's name doesn't say, read its Metadata/project_settings.config (unzip -p) and treat it as full-spectrum when it names a Full Spectrum filament profile.
